descriptions.counterfactual: A boat-shaped rattleback with fixed diagonal brass weights rests on a solid table, initially tilted on a retractable support. The support withdraws. With unchanged shape, weights and initial rocking, its rocking-to-spin coupling is wrongly reversed and it develops rotation in the opposite direction.
descriptions.true: A boat-shaped rattleback with fixed diagonal brass weights rests on a solid table, initially tilted on a retractable support. The support withdraws. Its initial rocking energy gradually becomes rotation in the preferred direction set by its asymmetric inertia and curved base.
